name: ph-civic-data
description: Live PH government data — earthquakes, weather, typhoons, procurement, population, infra-spending accountability, plus NASA / NOAA / World Bank feeds. 29 tools, no API keys required.
long_description: Multi-source MCP server for Philippine civic data. Includes PSGC location resolver, PHIVOLCS earthquakes and volcano alerts, PAGASA weather and typhoons, PhilGEPS procurement and infra-spending, PSA population and poverty stats, NASA POWER solar/climate, Open-Meteo air quality, NASA MODIS NDVI, USGS earthquakes, NOAA IBTrACS historical typhoons, and World Bank macro indicators. Cross-source tools surface multi-hazard risk profiles and heuristic infra anomaly indicators (for further review, never as evidence of wrongdoing).

pagasa_api_token.title: PAGASA TenDay API Token
pagasa_api_token.description: Optional. Without it, weather forecasts use Open-Meteo as a free fallback (covers the same PH cities). Token is gated by formal request to PAGASA — leave blank to skip.
